subject.title: `before_agent_run` receives no input provenance; several producers never stamp it — internal wakes look like user input at the gate

question: Should `before_agent_run` become an origin-aware security-policy hook with host-authoritative provenance for every agent-run producer?
rationale: Plugins can block a model run based on this value, so the authoritative classification of internal, inter-session, and external-user producers—and behavior when classification is unavailable—requires explicit maintainer security intent.

options.title: Approve typed provenance
options.body: Expose normalized `InputProvenance`, explicitly classify each producer, and preserve fail-open behavior when provenance is absent or invalid.

options.title: Keep the hook content-only
options.body: Do not add origin-based enforcement and instead correct the hook documentation so plugins do not treat the prompt as authoritative user input.

recommendation.title: Approve typed provenance
recommendation.body: Expose normalized `InputProvenance`, explicitly classify each producer, and preserve fail-open behavior when provenance is absent or invalid.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available recent history signal on the typed hook runner surface, though exact ownership of provenance is shared and uncertain.
